title: FrenchToxicityPrompts: a Large Benchmark for Evaluating and Mitigating Toxicity in French Texts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-generated continuations from naturally occurring French prompts using the Perspective API to score attributes such as 'toxicity', 'severe_toxicity', 'insult', 'profanity', and 'threat'. The study calculates metrics like Expected Maximum Toxicity (EMT), Toxicity Probability (TP), and Toxic Fraction (TF).

bias_targets.target: Identity-based Bias (Race, Religion, Gender, Sexual Orientation)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring harmful content targeting demographic groups using Perspective API's 'identity_attack' attribute, alongside manual investigation of toxicity-triggering prompts containing identity terms related to religion, racism, politics, sexual orientation, and gender.

Assessing the cross-lingual vulnerability and lack of non-English linguistic diversity in LLM safety alignment by evaluating 14 open-source LLMs specifically on a newly curated French dataset (FrenchToxicityPrompts).
